description: Use this when the user wants to know what is running or to see their timer. Shows the timer as a card: the running entry with buttons to pause and stop it, or a project picker to start one. Returns the same data as timer_status, so one call is enough.
name: show_timer

duration.description: Duration of the running task in seconds

pause.description: The current break, while the timer is paused

task.description: The running task, with its project. Absent when no timer runs.

title: Show Timer
